messages:
Alex: Quick Q — when the client aborts a streaming request mid-response, do we treat retries as deferred (i.e., keep state and attempt resume) or immediate hedged new request? I'm worried about double-cost + side-effects.

Tayla: We touched on resume tokens before but didn't land a policy. Guiding principle: user-visible idempotency wins. Read-only generation -> safe to hedge. Side-effectful flows -> no automatic retry.

Sanjay: Agree. Also cost-wise hedging duplicates tokens. Suggestion: implement a short 'deferred retry window' — keep a tiny lease (secs) where we decide between resume vs start-new based on K/V cache reconstructability and model compatibility.

Alex: Concrete proposal: on client abort, keep stream metadata for 5s lease. If the client reconnects with the same idempotency-key within 5s attempt resume. If not, allow hedging/failover path. Does 5s feel ok?

Jen: 5s seems fine for flaky mobile networks. Couple questions: how do we require/verify request identity? X-Request-Id or idempotency-key header? Also need tenant scoping to avoid cross-tenant leaks.

Kyle: Use an explicit `Idempotency-Key` header as canonical. Require same model-version + prompt fingerprint to qualify for resume. Also check KV-cache offset: only resume if last-known token-index within a small gap (e.g., <=32 tokens).

Tayla: Implementation detail: edge proxy should maintain a tiny in-memory "stream tombstone" keyed by (tenant, idempotency-key). Tombstone keeps {last-offset, model-id, checkpoint-hash, expiry-ts}. Evict after lease. No durable store required initially.

Sanjay: Add observability: metrics for `resume_attempts`, `resume_success`, `resume_fallbacks`, and `orphaned_streams`. Default knobs: lease=5s, gap=32. Expose per-tenant overrides in routing policy.

Alex: What about tool-calls / side-effects? If a request invoked tools we should never auto-retry server-side. Instead return a resume hint to client so they can decide.

Jen: Detecting side-effects: mark ingress requests with `side_effects=true` when SDK includes `allowed_functions` or prompt contains `<<CALL:` markers. SDKs should set idempotency-key and honor resume-hint header. We'll update docs.

Kyle: For additional safety we can record outbound webhook ids for a request and refuse server-side resume if any outbound call happened. It's heavier but prevents duplicate side-effects. Might be optional per-tenant.

Tayla: Action items: (1) prototype in edge with in-memory tombstones + metrics (Sanjay) (2) SDK changes to propagate `Idempotency-Key` and consume `Resume-Hint` (Jen) (3) add routing-policy config knobs for lease/gap per-tenant (Alex) (4) test harness for token-gap/resume correctness (Kyle). I'll spin up an RFC follow-up doc with diagrams.

Alex: Nice. Also consider making the lease adaptive: if upstream model latency spikes, extend small window to reduce wasted replays. But be cautious about resource retention.

Jen: +1 for adaptive window but let's start simple. I'll draft SDK changes and sample header names.

Alex: Thanks all. @deploy-bot can you queue a canary job that simulates mid-stream disconnects? :thinking:

deploy-bot: Added CI job `stream-resume-smoke` to nightly canary. Logs will push to `ci/stream-resume-smoke` and alert on resume_success < 95%. :thumbsup:
